name: stock-market-simulator
description: A moddable multi-system frontier simulation with colonies, production, markets and warfare.

scripts.build:win: vite build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-electron-app.ps1 && electron-builder --win dir --publish never && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-windows.ps1
scripts.build:runtime: vite build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-electron-app.ps1 && electron-builder --win dir --publish never && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sync-electron-runtime.ps1
scripts.check:syntax: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/storage.cjs && node --check electron/mod-loader.cjs && node --check electron/ini-parser.cjs && node --check electron/logger.cjs && node --check engine/index.cjs && node --check engine/catalog.cjs && node --check engine/simulation.cjs && node --check engine/clock.cjs && node --check engine/system-registry.cjs && node --check engine/campaign-time.cjs && node --check engine/random.cjs
